contextDiet.defaultCompressionLevel.description: Default compression level used for context menu copy and proxy compression.

contextDiet.enableLocalProxy.description: Enable local HTTP proxy server on port 8765 for CLI agents and API intercept.

contextDiet.proxyPort.description: Port number for the local HTTP proxy interceptor server.

contextDiet.stripComments.description: Remove developer comments and JSDoc blocks.

contextDiet.targetModelPricing.description: Model pricing tier used to estimate dollar savings in the dashboard.

contextDiet.autoInjectTerminalEnv.description: Automatically inject OPENAI_BASE_URL (…/v1) and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (no /v1) into integrated terminals so CLI agents route through ContextDiet's local proxy with zero manual setup. Applies to newly opened terminals.

contextDiet.enableSmartCopy.description: Smart Copy: when on, Ctrl/Cmd+C in a TypeScript/JavaScript editor copies the compressed selection instead of the raw text. Falls back to normal copy whenever compression would not help.

code.description: The TypeScript or JavaScript source code to compress.

languageModelTools.modelDescription: Compresses TypeScript/JavaScript source code by stripping comments, debug logging, unused imports and internal function bodies (depending on level: diet, skeleton, ultra-slim). Returns the compressed code plus token savings. Use this to shrink large TS/JS files before reasoning over them.
languageModelTools.name: contextdiet_compress
languageModelTools.userDescription: Compress TypeScript/JavaScript code with ContextDiet before using it as context.
